description.fun: Pawniard is made of blades from head to toe, and since a chip in them could prove fatal, it sharpens them after every battle on its own favourite stone by the river. Packs of Pawniard serve a Bisharp boss, attacking on its command and clanging their blades together after a slash, and each one trains hard, dreaming of one day taking the lead. Its name mixes 'pawn' with 'poniard', a small dagger.
description.guide: Pawniard is a Dark- and Steel-type Pokémon whose body is covered in blades. It lives in packs led by Bisharp. It evolves into Bisharp, then Kingambit.
description.tagline: A bladed foot soldier dreaming of leading the pack.

description.fun: Bisharp leads a pack of Pawniard, letting them hound prey to a standstill before it moves in, without changing its expression, to deal the finishing blow. It watches its minions closely to make sure none of them think of betraying it, and packs that lose territorial fights are absorbed into the winner's. But if the blade on its head is ever chipped, it retires as boss. Like a promoted chess pawn, Pawniard becomes a 'bishop'.
description.guide: Bisharp is the evolved form of Pawniard, a Dark- and Steel-type Pokémon that leads a pack of Pawniard. It evolves into Kingambit after defeating three Bisharp that hold a Leader's Crest.
description.tagline: A pitiless pack boss who retires if its head blade chips.

description.fun: Kingambit commands whole colonies of Pawniard and Bisharp as its personal army, and only the strongest Bisharp ever become one. It's hungry for battle but no great strategist, so it just keeps pushing forward with brute strength and sheer numbers. It looks like a shogun seated on a stool on the battlefield, and its name puns on the King's Gambit chess opening, completing the line's climb from pawn to bishop to king.
description.guide: Kingambit is the final form of Pawniard, a Dark- and Steel-type Pokémon that commands armies of Pawniard and Bisharp. It evolves from Bisharp after defeating three Bisharp that hold a Leader's Crest.
description.tagline: A samurai warlord commanding an army of blades.

transitions.how: Defeat three Bisharp holding a Leader's Crest
